description: Northern Territory Geological Faults 2500K is a dataset listed in Northern Territory Government open data portal (data.nt.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Mining and Energy. The faults and major structures of the Northern Territory that have been mapped from field data or by geophysical interpretation. Coverage: Northern Territory. The portal files it under the publisher Mining and Energy. Its tags are Geoscientific Information. It offers 4 resource(s) in html, kml, mapinfo tab, shp. The portal shows 2023-09-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-nt-government-open-data-portal.
